hero.sub: Schaefer is an international manufacturer and distributor of quality capsule filling equipment — machines to fit the needs of the pharmaceutical, health, nutrition, cannabis, automotive and manufacturing industries.

legacy.lead: Located in our 60,000 sq ft headquarters in Indianapolis, IN, Schaefer Technologies offers machines to fit the needs of the Pharmaceutical, Health, Nutrition, Cannabis, Automotive and Manufacturing industries. We are known for high quality products with great customer support — committed to Good Manufacturing Practices and to providing our customers with the best possible machines. Our most powerful tool? Commitment. The team and technology, brought together in a single entity.

machinesIntro.title: The full line
machinesIntro.body: Every machine below is manufactured or distributed by STI — specs as published.

machines.title: MSG_M2 MySoftGel
machines.body: The most compact encapsulating system available on the market — designed for minimum material loss for small production batches. Servo-motor injection, PLC touch-screen controls, AISI 316L product contact parts.

machines.alt: STI Model 10 ver 5.1 capsule filling machine
machines.title: STI Model 10 ver 5.1
machines.body: Semi-automatic, high-speed powder capsule filler for powder and pellets. 18,000–25,000 capsules per hour, sizes 000 through 5. Quick change-over from size to size.

machines.alt: STI LF10 liquid capsule filling machine
machines.title: STI LF10
machines.body: Liquid capsule filler operating up to 15,000 cph — fills paste and oils into gelatin or vegetable (HPMC) capsules. Built-in heater and stirrer.

machines.title: STI-Robofill
machines.body: Liquid capsule filling with fill weight tolerance ±2%. Capsule trays hold 300 capsules; stores up to 100 unique programs.

machines.title: RoboFill RF300 Series
machines.body: Versatile, expandable filling system for capsules, vape cartridges, disposable vape pens, bottles/tinctures and suppositories — from 1,400 cph to approx. 7,000 caps per hour.

machines.alt: RoboFill liquid filling head in operation
machines.title: RoboFill RF500
machines.body: Features a 500mm × 500mm workspace and a robotic arm that automatically fills and cycles 100 to 300 capsules per tray.

machines.title: STI RF-1 Filler
machines.body: Flexible, single-station, semi-automatic system for syringes, vape cartridges, pens, bottles/tinctures or suppositories. Tolerances ±1.5% free-flowing, ±3% viscous.

machines.title: ProFiller 3600
machines.body: 316 stainless steel, hand-held, 300-hole capsule filler for sizes 000–4, 00el and 2el.

machines.title: STI CB-15
machines.body: Capsule banding machine — bands up to 15,000* capsules per hour.

machines.alt: STI Labtop Bander capsule banding machine
machines.title: STI Labtop Bander
machines.body: Applies a tamper-evident band to the capsule cap/body joint — a pharmaceutically smooth, liquid-tight band. Perfect for low-volume runs, clinical trials, comparative or stability studies.

machines.title: STI-Slat Loader
machines.body: Removes the labor-intensive process of manually orienting capsules — pairs with the STI Lab-Top Capsule Bander.

machines.title: STI 4C & STI-4 Counters
machines.body: Automatic electronic multi-channel counters for precise counting of capsules or tablets for bottle filling — 15 L hopper, 4-channel vibratory feeder, infrared sensor system, up to 100 recipes.

machines.title: STI-4B Bagging Machine
machines.body: 6-station rotary bagger with premade pouch loading magazine, vacuum pick and place, and integrated counting. Bags 3"×6" to 6.5"×8", up to 30 bags per minute.

machines.title: CP-4200 Capsule Polisher
machines.body: Manufactured in the USA — 400,000 capsule per hour throughput. Soft nylon rotary brush with vacuum removal; no chemicals or disposable products.

machines.title: EnGuard Barrier Isolation
machines.body: Compounding isolators, the EnGuard VTC transport cart (maintains Class 100 conditions), cGMP sterile liquid filling isolation systems and a table-top isolator — HEPA filtered to ISO Class 5, 316L stainless.

machines.title: Autoturb3
machines.body: Microbiological assay system designed to test and analyze the potency of antibiotics, vitamins and related substances.

spotlight.title: Autoturb
spotlight.body: Assays virtually all known antibiotics — plus vitamins including B12, Folic Acid, Niacinamide, Pyridoxine (B6), Pantothenic Acid and Panthenol. Reader & diluter module with digital spectrophotometer turbidity readout.

news.title: SCHAEFER: The Best Kept Secret in Capsule Manufacturing
news.synopsis: A profile of STI's decades-long run solving manufacturing and distribution challenges for the capsule industry since 1932.
fullText: Schaefer Technologies Inc. has been solving manufacturing and distribution challenges since 1932. As an engineering and equipment manufacturing company, we've dedicated ourselves to designing and providing manufacturing equipment that makes capsule filling easy, efficient, and effective.

After 90 years in the manufacturing industry, we understand the critical demand for efficiency and effective manufacturing processes. We also understand that one of the essential investments a capsule manufacturer can make is in equipment.
SOLUTIONS: How Can Manufacturers Minimize Waste and Maximize Performance?

The demand for quality capsule machine equipment is projected to increase by approximately 90 million dollars by 2027. As the needs of our manufacturing partners increase, we continue to provide innovative and effective machine equipment to minimize waste and maximize production, resulting in greater profitability.

Human error can lead to spills, inaccurate pouring, and decreased production rate. However, our equipment can help automate manufacturing operations with precision filling and fail-safe features to produce effective capsule positioning, filling, and locking.

Our machines provide manufacturers a choice of equipment capable of filling various capsule sizes and materials. Our machines are designed for product-switching capabilities to help manufacturers easily switch between liquids, pastes, or oil into gelatin or vegetable (HPMC) capsules.
STRATEGY: How Can Automation Make Manufacturing More Efficient?

Our highly advanced and sophisticated machinery can help manufacturing operators receive the highest protection while maximizing output. By minimizing user interaction with a compact design, our machines can automate the capsule-filling process, which translates into additional cost savings.

We offer manual, semi-automatic, and automatic types to fit your custom manufacturing needs. However, we understand that manufacturers have varying needs that require custom solutions. As a machine manufacturer, we offer custom machinery design services to help our manufacturing partners maximize operational efficiency.

Several of our machines feature a heated hopper and stirrer with a temperature sensor to prevent plugging and maintain a free material flow throughout production. This enables a versatile production capability for various capsule sizes and product viscosity.
SERVICE & SUPPORT: Skip Supply Chain Disruption

With 90 years of experience in the industry and regulatory environment, we have designed our machines to be easily operated, cleaned, and maintained. Our reliable support specialists can supply replacement or change parts, on-site field service and training, and toll-free technical support when problems arise.

Through our services, manufacturers aren't held back by supply chain shortages, shipping delays, or long periods of downtime. We're equipped and capable of responding to any machine needs to meet your critical scheduling.
In conclusion, we help manufacturers leverage new technologies to drive efficient production, streamline operation performance, and maximize capsule processing.

news.title: Autoturb³
news.synopsis: Inside the Autoturb3 microbiological assay system — built by STI to test the potency of antibiotics and vitamins like B12, Folic Acid, and Pyridoxine (B6).
fullText: The Autoturb3 Microbiological Assay System is manufactured by STI (Schaefer Technologies, Inc.). It is designed to test and analyze the potency of antibiotics, vitamins and related substances. This system can be used to assay virtually all known antibiotics. The Autoturb3 can also assay many vitamins, including the following: B12, Folic Acid, Niacinamide, Pyridoxine (B6), Pantothenic Acid and Panthenol.
The complete system consists of 2 modules:
Reader and Diluter Module: Automatically prepares the required dilution of the sample and the standard reference substance with an inoculated liquid growth medium.
Spectrophotometer displaying a digital indication of turbidity of the killed suspension in each sample.

news.title: Barrier Isolation
news.synopsis: A look at STI's EnGuard table-top isolator, delivering an ISO Class 5 HEPA-filtered clean environment for smaller pharmacies and healthcare facilities.
fullText: Compounding Isolator: The EnGuard compounding isolator provides safe containment and eliminates cross contamination. These isolators are designed primarily for small volume processes including laboratory testing and clinical trial investigations. EnGuard compounding isolators are single chambers with ergonomic glove port access to areas where operator intervention is required. Process equipment can be removed using a sliding platform which makes maintenance, major changeovers and cleaning all much easier.

Transport Cart: The EnGuard VTC is designed to provide protection for both product and personnel. Typically, the transfer carts are used to move the aseptically filled vials, with partially seated stoppers, through non-controlled areas providing a class A / class 100 environment during the transport of the products. The 316L stainless steel interior and exterior provides cleanable surfaces that are finished to pharmaceutical cGMP standards. The vial transfer cart environment is HEPA filtered with unidirectional airflow, which can be either re-circulated or exhausted.

Sterile Liquid Filling: Schaefer Technologies, Inc / EnGuard Systems is your single source supplier for cGMP Sterile Liquid Filling Isolation Systems. Perfect for R&D, Clinical Trials, Pilot Plant and Small Batch Production.

Table Top Isolator: Need an ISO Class 5 Hepa Filtered clean room environment in a mini-isolator version to handle those smaller applications? The STI EnGuard Systems Table-Top Isolator is the answer. Designed for smaller pharmacies, physicians, and health care facilities. Features: 316L stainless construction, Isolator Hepa Filtered to ISO Class 5 levels, Positive or Negative pressure, docking station for transporting and introducing potent compounds, and (2) piece nitrile gloves for greater flexibility.

news.title: Tablet & Capsule Counters
news.synopsis: The STI-4 tablet and capsule counter — precise, high-speed counting for bottle filling across capsule and tablet types.
fullText: STI-4 Tablet Capsule Counter: The STI-4 Tablet Capsule Counter is manufactured for precise counting of all types of capsules, tablets for bottle filling. The machine consists of a 15 liter hopper, four channel vibratory feeder, infrared sensor system and the ability to program up to 100 recipes.

news.title: Capsule Banding
news.synopsis: The CB-15 bands the cap-and-body joint of filled capsules — a tamper-evident seal built for high-volume production.
fullText: STI-CB 15 Capsule Banding Machine: The CB-15 is designed to band the joint portions of the cap and body of the filled gelatin or non-gelatin capsules. The banding takes place as the capsules pass over two rollers that are partially immersed in gelatin or non-gelatin material, which is electrically heated and temperature controlled. The result is a smooth, liquid-tight band, which produces a seamless joined capsule. The result of this process is a banded capsule that prevents leakage of product, reduces oxidation of the product, minimizes odor problems, and most importantly, provides a tamper resistant band. The CB-15 has a maximum capacity of 15,000 capsules per hour.

STI LabTop Capsule Banding Machine: Simulates the banding process of a high-speed production banding machine. The machine is capable of producing approximately 100 banded capsules per hour making it perfect for low-volume runs for clinical trials, comparative studies, stability studies, etc. Once banded, the capsule is almost impossible to open and re-close without leaving evidence of tampering. The ease of changeover from one capsule to another also makes it possible to evaluate a variety of capsule and banding color combinations.
STI-Slat Loader: Designed to remove the labor intensive process of manually orientating and loading the filled gelatin or vegetable based (HPMC) capsules into the slats for the STI LabTop Bander.
